title.ja: 図1-1 先手なら角交換を拒否できる
title.en: Figure 1-1: As Black, you can refuse the bishop exchange

explain.ja: 角交換の将棋は基本的に避けられません。先手なら▲7六歩、△3四歩、▲6六歩と角道を閉じれば避けられますが、後手では、角道を開けた瞬間に相手から角交換を挑まれる可能性があります。最初から角道を開けなければ避けられますが、かなり変わった駒組みになります。
explain.en: Games with a bishop exchange basically cannot be avoided. As Black you can avoid it by closing the diagonal with ▲7六歩, △3四歩, ▲6六歩, but as White the opponent may offer the exchange the moment you open your diagonal. Never opening it avoids the exchange but leads to quite unusual piece placement.

section.ja: 角交換は基本的に拒否できない
section.en: A bishop exchange basically can't be refused

explain.ja: 「角交換には5筋の歩を突くな」という格言があります。図2-1のように5筋の歩を突いた駒組みをするとどうなるでしょうか。
explain.en: There is a proverb: "don't push the 5th-file pawn in a bishop exchange game". What happens with the formation that pushes the 5th-file pawn, as in Figure 2-1?

section.ja: 角交換には5筋の歩を突くな!
section.en: Don't push the 5th-file pawn against a bishop exchange!

title.ja: 図2-2 馬を作られてしまう

explain.ja: 5筋の歩を突いていると、△3九角から馬を作られる筋が生じます。角成の隙をなくすため、5筋の歩を突かない駒組みを心がけます。角交換の将棋では金を1段目に待機させる形がよく現れ、居飛車では右の金、振り飛車では左の金を動かさずに組みます。図2-3、図2-4の1段金の駒組みは、どちらも自陣に角を打たれる隙がありません。
explain.en: With the 5th-file pawn pushed, White can drop △3九角 and make a horse. To remove the chance of promoting the bishop, avoid pushing the 5th-file pawn. In bishop exchange games a gold is often kept on the first rank: the right gold in Static Rook, the left gold in Ranging Rook. In the formations of Figures 2-3 and 2-4 there is no hole for a bishop drop into your camp.

section.ja: 角交換には5筋の歩を突くな!
section.en: Don't push the 5th-file pawn against a bishop exchange!

title.ja: 図2-3 居飛車での1段金の駒組み
title.en: Figure 2-3: First-rank gold formation in Static Rook

explain.ja: 5筋の歩を突いていると、△3九角から馬を作られる筋が生じます。角成の隙をなくすため、5筋の歩を突かない駒組みを心がけましょう。角交換の将棋では、金を1段目に待機させる形がよく現れます。居飛車では右の金、振り飛車では左の金を動かさずに駒組みを進めます。図2-3、図2-4では、どちらも自陣に角を打たれる隙がありません。
explain.en: If the fifth-file pawn has been pushed, White can drop a bishop on 3九 and make a promoted bishop. To remove that opening, aim for setups that do not push the fifth-file pawn. In bishop-exchange games, a formation that keeps a gold on the first rank often appears: in Static Rook the right gold, and in Ranging Rook the left gold, is left unmoved. In both Figures 2-3 and 2-4, there is no gap for a bishop drop in one's own camp.

section.en: Defending with a gold on the first rank

title.ja: 図2-4 振り飛車での1段金の駒組み
title.en: Figure 2-4: First-rank gold formation in Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 角打ちの隙はなくなりますが、囲いは薄くなるので注意が必要です。角交換の将棋では、飛車を1段目に下ろす駒組みもあります。1段目に飛車の横利きを通して角打ちの隙をなくします。居飛車と振り飛車それぞれの例の図2-5、図2-6で、角打ちの隙がないことを確認します。
explain.en: This removes the bishop-drop hole but thins the castle, so be careful. In bishop exchange games there is also a formation lowering the rook to the first rank, whose sideways control along the back rank removes the bishop-drop weakness. Check in Figures 2-5 and 2-6, examples for Static Rook and Ranging Rook, that no bishop-drop hole exists.

section.en: Defending with a gold on the first rank

title.ja: 図2-5 居飛車での1段飛車の駒組み
title.en: Figure 2-5: First-rank rook formation in Static Rook

explain.ja: 角交換の将棋では、飛車を1段目に下ろす駒組みもあります。1段目に飛車の横効きを通すことで、角打ちの隙をなくします。図2-5、図2-6で、居飛車と振り飛車それぞれの例を見て、角打ちの隙がないことを確認してください。角打ちの隙は無くなりますが、囲いは薄くなるので注意が必要です。
explain.en: In bishop-exchange games, there are also setups that drop the rook to the first rank. Having the rook's sideways reach cover the first rank removes the gaps for a bishop drop. Check in Figures 2-5 and 2-6, the Static Rook and Ranging Rook examples, that there is no gap for a bishop drop. Note that the castle becomes thinner, even though the gaps disappear.

section.en: Defending with a rook on the first rank

title.ja: 図2-6 振り飛車での1段飛車の駒組み
title.en: Figure 2-6: First-rank rook formation in Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 金を2段目に上げて桂馬を跳ねます。角交換での駒組みのコツは、5筋の歩を突かない、1段金で組む、1段飛車で組む、の3つです。
explain.en: The gold goes up to the second rank and the knight jumps. The tips for piece placement after a bishop exchange are: don't push the 5th-file pawn, build with a gold on the first rank, and build with the rook on the first rank.

section.en: Defending with a rook on the first rank

title.ja: 図3-1 後手が飛車先の歩を交換
title.en: Figure 3-1: White exchanges the rook's pawn

explain.ja: 図3-1は後手が飛車先の歩を交換してきたところです。ここで手拍子で▲8七歩としてしまいそうですが、手筋があります。
explain.en: Figure 3-1 shows White having exchanged the rook pawn. You might reflexively play ▲8七歩 here, but there is a tesuji.

title.ja: 図3-2 王手飛車が決まる

explain.ja: 図3-1からは▲9五角で王手飛車が決まります。初心者は意外とうっかりしやすい筋なので、よく覚えておきましょう。
explain.en: From Figure 3-1, ▲9五角 wins with a check-rook fork. Beginners often overlook this pattern, so remember it well.

title.ja: 図3-3 相振り飛車での角打ち
title.en: Figure 3-3: Bishop drop in Double Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 図3-3は角交換で相振り飛車になった形です。一見普通の駒組みですが、ここで角打ちの隙があります。
explain.en: Figure 3-3 is a double Ranging Rook formation after a bishop exchange. It looks ordinary, but there is a bishop-drop weakness.

section.en: Making a horse with the Suji-chigai Bishop

title.ja: 図3-4 次に馬を作れるのが確定する
title.en: Figure 3-4: Making a horse next is guaranteed

explain.ja: 図3-3から▲5六角と打てば、後手は次の▲2三角成と▲8三角成を両方は受けられず、先手は馬を作れることが確定します。実戦では▲6五角も頻出ですが、この局面ではあまり効果はありません。
explain.en: From Figure 3-3, ▲5六角 means White cannot stop both ▲2三角成 and ▲8三角成, so Black is sure to make a horse. ▲6五角 also occurs often in real games, though it is less effective in this position.

section.en: Making a horse with the Suji-chigai Bishop

title.ja: 図3-5 美濃囲いに組もうとしたところ
title.en: Figure 3-5: Trying to build a Mino castle

explain.ja: 図3-5は後手が美濃囲いに組もうとしたところで、ここにも角打ちの隙があります。
explain.en: Figure 3-5 shows White trying to build a Mino castle, and here too there is a bishop-drop weakness.

section.ja: 美濃囲いへの角の打ち込み
section.en: Bishop drop into the Mino castle

title.ja: 図3-6 美濃囲いの中に角打ち
title.en: Figure 3-6: Bishop drop inside the Mino castle

explain.ja: 図3-5からは美濃囲いの中に角を打つ隙があり、次に香車取りが残ります。後手が△9二香と逃げても、▲9一角成から香車を取って駒得です。角交換で美濃囲いに組むときは、先に玉を8二まで持っていく必要があります。
explain.en: From Figure 3-5 a bishop can be dropped into the Mino castle, leaving a lance capture next. Even if White escapes with △9二香, ▲9一角成 wins the lance for a material gain. When building a Mino castle in a bishop exchange game, the king must go to 8二 first.

section.ja: 美濃囲いへの角の打ち込み
section.en: Bishop drop into the Mino castle
